window_note: the window starts at the last FINISHED Auditor run (audit_prescreen STAMP); no stamp: now - fallback_window_days; older than max_window_days: clamped (a 7-day window re-raised ~57 hard flags a run)
weights_note: hand multipliers; effective weight = mult * min(info_cap_bits, -log2(rate in window))

hardflag_filer._why: AUDITOR_BUILD_HARD_FLAG_FILER_NO_AI (GPT review #6, roles/auditor.md step 1): hard flags are filed by a program in the Auditor's pre_launch so they never depend on audit capacity
hardflag_filer._max_prescreen_age_s_why: the pre_launch rewrites prescreen.json seconds before this runs; anything older means that step did not run, and the filer refuses rather than act on a list nobody refreshed
hardflag_filer._fallback_for_why: an item owned by a retired seat (BUILD, CHECK, REP...) goes to BENCH, which owns RimFlow and the ledger's records
